semiconductor_relevance: High — Shenzhen HENGKO Filter Co., Ltd. specializes in nanoscale gas filtration solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shenzhen HENGKO Filter Co., Ltd. provides advanced gas filtration solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on ultra-high purity gas sources essential for processes like photolithography and etching. The company utilizes 316L stainless steel filter elements to effectively intercept particles as small as 3nm, ensuring reliable performance and cost-effective solutions for domestic semiconductor companies.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in the Pinghu semiconductor industrial ecosystem of Longgang District, Shenzhen, focusing on domestic production and supply chain efficiency.
